meaning: An AI advisory indicating that the evaluated rule set has not identified a condition within its configured scope that warrants recommending departure delay or adjustment. The rule system found no active Delay antecedent in the resolved environmental inputs.
expected_payload: reason: brief rationale stating no adverse condition was identified by the rule system
human_interpretation: The rule system found no condition in its scope to recommend delay. The fisher retains full authority to decide whether to depart.
what_it_does_not_mean: Does not mean: safe to depart; approved to depart; risk-free departure; guaranteed safe conditions; permission to depart; absence of all hazards; that conditions outside the rule system scope are acceptable.
evidence_source: Rahim et al. (2024) fishing season behavioral regime — full operations under calm conditions; Gao (2024) tripartite go/cautious-go/no-go decision structure; dataset-label-derivation.md Section 4 label logic
evidence_location: docs/implementation/dataset-label-derivation.md §4; notes/Survival Decisions and Adaptation Strategies...; notes/Mapping the decision-making factors...

meaning: An AI advisory recommending that the fisher defer departure pending improvement in the identified adverse condition. The advisory identifies the specific condition(s) within the rule system's scope that triggered the recommendation.
decision_variable_affected: Whether to proceed with departure; timing of departure
expected_payload: reason: the specific environmental condition that triggered the rule
human_interpretation: The rule system has identified a condition warranting caution about immediate departure. The fisher should assess whether conditions improve. Departure authority remains with the fisher.
what_it_does_not_mean: Does not mean: departure is prohibited; the fisher must not go; conditions are unsafe per MET Malaysia classification (that is a Layer 2 determination); that delay guarantees improved conditions; that the system can predict when conditions will improve.
evidence_source: MET Malaysia Category 1 = berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil (dangerous to small boats); Rahim et al. (2024) East season restricted operations; Gao (2024) cautious-go pattern; Jeong & Im (2023) departure restriction framework; dataset-label-derivation.md Section 4 Delay rows
evidence_location: docs/implementation/dataset-label-derivation.md §4; notes/Proposal of Restrictions...; notes/Survival Decisions...; MET Malaysia warning criteria

meaning: An AI advisory recommending a specific departure window or departure time based on environmental and operational evidence. Available only in SAFE state.
expected_payload: time_window: a recommended departure time or range — OPEN
human_interpretation: If populated: the rule system recommends departing within the indicated time window based on evaluated evidence. Fisher retains authority to choose departure time.
what_it_does_not_mean: Does not mean: this is the optimal fishing time; departure outside this window is unsafe; it is derived from sunrise/sunset alone; that the rule system can optimise catch outcomes.
evidence_source: None — no scientific authority identified in the repository for a specific departure time recommendation beyond sunrise. dataset-label-derivation.md Section 6.3 explicitly defers this to RQ5 fieldwork.

meaning: An AI advisory recommending a maximum or suggested trip duration based on environmental and operational evidence. Available only in SAFE state.
expected_payload: hours: recommended trip duration or maximum — OPEN
human_interpretation: If populated: the rule system recommends a trip duration not exceeding the indicated hours given current conditions. Fisher retains authority to decide trip duration.
what_it_does_not_mean: Does not mean: trips longer than this are certain to encounter dangerous conditions; the system can predict weather windows with accuracy; that this duration is optimal for catch; that it is derived from sunset time alone.
evidence_source: None — no scientific authority identified in the repository for specific trip duration recommendations within SAFE state. Rahim et al. (2024) documents duration reduction under extreme conditions (UNSAFE state) where Layer 3 does not reason. dataset-label-derivation.md Section 6.3 explicitly defers this to RQ5 fieldwork.
evidence_location: dataset-label-derivation.md §6.3; notes/Survival Decisions and Adaptation Strategies...
